test_title: PYST 33: RRB NTPC Graduate Level CBT-I - Reasoning (Held On: 19 Jun, 2025 Shift 1)
subject: reasoning
question:
Read the given statements and conclusions carefully. Assuming that the information given in the statements is true, even if it appears to be at variance with commonly known facts, decide which of the given conclusion(s) logically follow(s) from the statements.

Statements:

All sweater are jacket.

All sweater are coat.

All coat are blazer.

Conclusions:

(I) All sweater are blazer.

(II) Some coat are jacket.
solution:
The least possible Venn diagram for the given statements is as shown below :

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/429aba673c2c7d6c310d94686fb3d2c2bdd12e5cbab27ef6fa02c6c8a6dc602c.png] 

Conclusions:

(I) All sweater are blazer → Follow (As all sweater are coat and all coat are blazer. As whole sweater comes in coat which whole comes in blazer, therefore it is true)

(II) Some coat are jacket → Follow (As all sweater are jacket and all sweater are coat. As whole sweater comes in coats and jacket, therefore it is true)

∴ Here, Both conclusions (I) and (II) follow.​

Hence, the correct answer is "Option 4".
